angle: Wind the company down and ask government for help
title: Close the company; ask government to cover the gap
answer: The council winds the company down, stops new lending and sells its 410 homes within two years, publishing the buyer before signing. Protect existing council tenants, rents, care and children’s services. Use the expected £31m sale proceeds and £8m reserves; request a £35m government grant, paid by national taxpayers. The council’s finance director publishes who authorised the £74m loan and quarterly accounts showing receipts, the remaining gap and homes sold. Success means all 410 sold and balanced books this year and next without new borrowing. Until government agrees and the money arrives, the books do not balance. A begging letter is not £35m.
